highlights: Agentic AI development is rapidly advancing with new frameworks enabling self-improvement, continual learning, and robust evaluation, significantly boosting agent reliability and performance.
Frontier models are pushing boundaries with multimodal capabilities, vastly extended context windows, and open-weight releases, empowering developers with more powerful and accessible AI.
Critical infrastructure and optimization tools for AI deployment are emerging, alongside specialized benchmarks, streamlining the development and scaling of sophisticated AI systems.

agents.title: CopilotKit Releases CLiF: Continual Learning Platform for Agents
agents.summary: CopilotKit introduced CLiF, a platform that transforms agent traces and user interactions into valuable data for skill acquisition, evaluation, and fine-tuning, directly addressing the challenge of deploying robust AI agents at scale.

agents.title: ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop
agents.summary: ClawLoop offers a framework for self-improving LLM-based agents in harness environments, enabling them to iteratively synthesize tasks, train, and diagnose performance without relying on external teacher models, leading to consistent gains on benchmarks.

agents.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
agents.summary: Harness^2 introduces a recursive agent harnessing framework that refines task-specific harnesses and updates a continual improvement harness, allowing agents to self-improve and adapt to novel open-world tasks without ground-truth verifiers.

models.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Argon API With 1M Token Output Limit
models.summary: Google has made Gemini 4 Argon generally available, a sparse MoE model offering an unprecedented 1M token output limit via API, AI Studio, and the Gemini app, setting a new standard for long-form content generation and complex task execution.

models.title: Meta Launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full: Benchmarks, Pricing and How to Use It
models.summary: Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, new 1M-context agent models. Muse Wonder offers competitive pricing on the Meta Model API, while Wonder Full leads in deep software engineering benchmarks, providing powerful options for agent development.

models.title: Welcome Muse Spark Open: Open-Weight Frontier Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Model from Meta
models.summary: Meta introduced Muse Spark Open, an open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model, providing the open-source community with access to advanced capabilities for multimodal AI development and research.

tools.title: 9 Best AI Gateways in 2026: Bifrost, Portkey, LiteLLM, Kong and 5 More Ranked
tools.summary: MarkTechPost published a comprehensive ranking of nine leading AI gateways, comparing solutions like Bifrost, Portkey, and LiteLLM across critical factors such as latency, pricing, licensing, and deployment, offering builders crucial insights for infrastructure decisions.

tools.title: Echo: Error-Compensated 4-Bit Tensor-Parallel Communication for LLM Training and Inference
tools.summary: Echo introduces a 4-bit all-reduce method for LLM training and inference that controls accumulated errors, significantly accelerating communication (up to 2.09x faster) and improving throughput while maintaining model quality, without requiring specialized hardware.

tools.title: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0: Automating Diverse Task Construction and Measuring Sustained Agent Progress
tools.summary: LHTB 2.0 expands to 77 tasks across 13 domains, offering a hardened and process-aware testbed for evaluating agents over extended workflows (up to three hours) with dense progress ladders, providing a more granular and realistic assessment of sustained agent performance.

companies.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Argon API With 1M Token Output Limit
companies.summary: Google has made its frontier Gemini 4 Argon model widely available through its API, AI Studio, and the Gemini app, empowering developers, enterprises, and scientists with its advanced capabilities and a significant 1M token output limit.

companies.title: Meta Launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full: Benchmarks, Pricing and How to Use It
companies.summary: Meta's release of Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full provides new 1M-context agent models, signaling a significant push into advanced agentic AI capabilities for both general use and specialized tasks like software engineering.

companies.title: openKylin Outlines Its Vision for Reimagining Linux in the AI Era at Open Source Summit Europe 2026
companies.summary: openKylin unveiled its strategic vision to transition Linux from resource management to intent management in the AI era, introducing KART (a unified AI runtime) and AI-enhanced core desktop features in openKylin 3.0, setting a new direction for open-source OS in AI.

learning.title: Teaching Students to Think and Learn Through Questions
learning.summary: OpenAI highlights how its AI tools, including Study Mode, can help teachers foster active, step-by-step learning, promoting deeper understanding through question-based engagement in educational settings.

learning.title: Helping Teens Learn, Plan, and Shape the Future of AI
learning.summary: OpenAI is rolling out College Planner and new learning features like flashcards and quizzes within ChatGPT for Teens, alongside a teen AI council, to support students in their educational planning and engagement with AI's future.

learning.title: DevFest is back
learning.summary: Google announced the return of DevFest 2026, a global event with over 800 local gatherings, offering developers opportunities to learn, build, secure, and scale solutions in the agentic AI era.
